body: 基于上传银色无线鼠标重做材质：保持鼠标轮廓、滚轮、按键缝和角度，改为透明虹彩玻璃，有蓝绿紫色折射与色散。黑色背景，HDRI斜向主光、边缘轮廓光、克制辉光、高对比。仅一只鼠标，不新增物体、不改变外形，方图。

instructions.en: Upload the reference images in the listed order. The example uses synthetic input images.

en.title: Object to iridescent glass
en.description: Mouse outline, split buttons and scroll wheel are retained, with transparent rainbow glass and rim light against black.
en.body:
## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. Upload the ordered synthetic reference images shown in the run before generating.

## Observed result

Mouse outline, split buttons and scroll wheel are retained, with transparent rainbow glass and rim light against black.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 52. [Source](https://github.com/jamez-bondos/awesome-gpt4o-images/blob/main/README_en.md). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.
